$doc: Menu page animation spec — Webflow IX2 → GSAP conversion. Companion doc: menu-animations.md. Raw decoded IX2 source: webflow-ix2-menu.raw.json (38 events / 10 action lists, filtered from the same site-wide registry used for home-animations.json — see that doc's recipe dictionary for shared moves).

meta.engine: Webflow IX2 (events + actionLists), shared registry with the home page
meta.sharedRecipes: riseBlurFade (a-48/a-33), curtainWipe (a-32), tab cascade (a-171), product hover (a-43/a-44), navbar recolor (a-23/a-25 pattern, here a-114) — see home-animations.json for full definitions. Not redefined here.

splitLetterReveal.description: Hero title reveal — unlike home's whole-word hero timeline, menu's H1 is split into individual letter masks (each letter in an overflow-hidden mask, starting translateY(100%)) and rises into view letter-by-letter. Matches the site's custom GSAP SplitText module used for button-label rolls, applied here to a heading instead.

slideInLeft.description: Mirror of home's slideInRight (see home-animations.json). Guide section images enter from the left instead of the right — the two sections face opposite directions in the original layout.

ctaExplosionSettle.description: actionList a-112 — the CTA section's signature move. A continuous SCROLL_PROGRESS interaction across the pinned section's full scroll range (0-100%): the center title holds at scale 1.2 through 15%, then eases to scale 1 by 25%; the 8-image collage is invisible and scattered until 20%, fades in by 26% already in a wide 'burst' spread, then drifts inward to a tight 'settled' arrangement by 70%, then the whole collage exits upward (yPercent -100) by 80%.

gsap.note: Implemented as one scrubbed timeline (scrub:1) spanning the pinned wrapper's top-top to bottom-bottom. Per-image burst/settled xPercent/yPercent pairs are decoded 1:1 from the source (values are already percentage-of-self, directly portable to GSAP xPercent/yPercent).

ambientOrbit.description: actionList a-113 — fires on PAGE_START (not scroll), loops forever. The image collage wrapper rotates a full 360deg over 25s while each image counter-rotates -360deg over the same duration, so individual images stay upright while their positions slowly orbit the collage center. A pure ambient/idle touch, independent of scroll.

meta.responsiveNote: On small/tiny breakpoints the original swaps a-112's scrub choreography for plain discrete a-48 rise-blur-fade reveals on the title and 3 of the 8 images (not all 8) — the elaborate percentage-based collage math is intentionally dropped on narrow viewports. The GSAP conversion mirrors this with an isDesktop matchMedia branch.
